title: Locate active 3EN Security Monitor GUI
description: Large read-only Windows-side source discovery for the active 3EN Security Monitor GUI. Locates candidate GUI/source/data files, running processes and command lines, searches for block/unblock, multi-select, blacklist, history and 3en-threats.json references, and creates a timestamped backup copy of candidate text/source files under C:\3EN-Agent\backups\016. No application logic is changed.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $BackupRoot=Join-Path 'C:\3EN-Agent\backups\016' $stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BackupRoot | Out-Null; Set-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-016-current.txt' -Value $BackupRoot -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$BackupRoot); Write-Host 'BACKUP_016_READY'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $BackupRoot=(Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-016-current.txt' -Raw).Trim(); Write-Host '=== 3EN SECURITY MONITOR SOURCE DISCOVERY 016 ==='; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$BackupRoot); $roots=@('E:\skrypty','C:\3EN-Agent',([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop')),([Environment]::GetFolderPath('MyDocuments')))|Where-Object{$_ -and (Test-Path $_)}|Select-Object -Unique; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== RUNNING CANDIDATE PROCESSES ==='; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'python|pythonw|powershell|pwsh|node|3en' -and $_.CommandLine -match '3en|security|monitor|threat|block' } | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,ExecutablePath,CommandLine | Format-List | Out-String -Width 500 | Write-Host; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== CANDIDATE FILES ==='; $all=@(); foreach($root in $roots){ Write-Host ('--- SEARCH '+$root+' ---'); $items=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '(?i)(3en|security.?monitor|threat|blocklist|blacklist)' -or $_.Extension -in '.py','.ps1','.js','.html','.htm','.json','.css' } | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 5MB }; $all += $items }; $all=$all | Sort-Object FullName -Unique; $candidates=@(); foreach($f in $all){ $match=$false; if($f.Name -match '(?i)(3en|security.?monitor|threat|blocklist|blacklist)'){$match=$true}; if(-not $match -and $f.Extension -in '.py','.ps1','.js','.html','.htm','.json'){ try{$txt=Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Raw -ErrorAction Stop; if($txt -match '(?i)(en3_block4|3en-threats|security-monitor|unblock|blacklist|blocklist)'){$match=$true}}catch{} }; if($match){$candidates += $f} }; $candidates=$candidates|Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending -Unique; $candidates | Select-Object -First 120 FullName,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 300 | Write-Host; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== BACKUP CANDIDATE SOURCES ==='; foreach($f in ($candidates|Select-Object -First 80)){ if($f.Extension -in '.py','.ps1','.js','.html','.htm','.json','.css','.txt'){ $safe=($f.FullName -replace '[:\/]','_'); Copy-Item -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Destination (Join-Path $BackupRoot $safe) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Host 'BACKUP_CANDIDATES_DONE'; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== SYMBOL SEARCH ==='; $patterns=@('en3_block4','3en-threats','security-monitor','unblock','blocklist','blacklist','selected','selection','multi','history','manual'); foreach($f in ($candidates|Select-Object -First 80)){ if($f.Extension -notin '.py','.ps1','.js','.html','.htm','.json','.css','.txt'){continue}; try{$lines=Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -ErrorAction Stop}catch{continue}; $hits=@(); for($i=0;$i -lt $lines.Count;$i++){ foreach($p in $patterns){ if($lines[$i] -match [regex]::Escape($p)){ $hits += [pscustomobject]@{Line=$i+1;Text=$lines[$i].Trim()}; break } } }; if($hits.Count -gt 0){ Write-Host ('--- FILE '+$f.FullName+' ---'); $hits|Select-Object -First 80|Format-Table -AutoSize|Out-String -Width 500|Write-Host } }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '=== EXACT DATA FILE SEARCH ==='; foreach($root in $roots){ Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -File -Recurse -Filter '3en-threats.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-List | Out-String -Width 300 | Write-Host }; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'DISCOVERY_016=PASS'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $b=(Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:\3EN-Agent\backup-016-current.txt' -Raw).Trim(); if(-not(Test-Path $b)){throw '016 backup directory missing'}; Write-Host ('BACKUP_EXISTS='+$b); Write-Host 'VALIDATION_016=PASS'
rollback: Write-Host 'READ-ONLY DISCOVERY TASK: no rollback required; backup copies only.'
